metadata.name: Roller
metadata.summary: Reverse-engineered modern source port of the classic 1995 stunt racing game Fatal Racing and Whiplash

content.value: Roller is an open-source, reverse-engineered source port of Fatal Racing (also known as Whiplash), the high-speed 1995 3D stunt racing game originally developed by Gremlin Interactive. Built with modern systems in mind, the project substitutes DOS-specific internals with modern libraries such as SDL3, allowing the classic game to run smoothly on contemporary hardware.
The engine supports loading original assets directly from retail disc images or playable demo archives, delivering authentic gameplay with updated cross-platform support.

items.value: Full reimplementation of original Fatal Racing and Whiplash game mechanics and 3D physics
Cross-platform multimedia backend powered by SDL3 and SDL_image
Authentic MIDI music synthesis and audio playback using WildMIDI
Direct asset extraction from retail CD-ROM disc images including CUE/BIN and ISO formats
In-game settings overlay and UI menus integrated via Nuklear
Support for loading both bundled freeware demo data and complete retail game assets
